scope: fresh-seed CPU feasibility pilot; never paper formal evidence

gates.P1_validity_pairing_and_accounting: all rows finite; exact task/method/profile/seed/checkpoint set; paired initialization and evaluation; complete and partial work charged; owner self-fresh
gates.P2_positive_learning: mean final-minus-initial return is positive for every task x method aggregate across both profiles
gates.P3_heterogeneous_auc_gain: offdiag_async minus frozen_barrier mean AUC, normalized by absolute paired initial return, is at least 0.05 overall and positive on each task
gates.P4_heterogeneous_directionality: offdiag_async has larger AUC than frozen_barrier in at least 60% of paired heterogeneous seed x task cells
gates.P5_async_reference_safety: offdiag_async normalized AUC is no more than 0.02 below the stronger of raw_async and delay_scaled_async overall and on either task
gates.P6_rate_coupling_order: offdiag-versus-barrier normalized AUC gain is strictly larger under heterogeneous than balanced service for each task
gates.P7_nontrivial_lyapunov_design: the declared off-diagonal multiplier lies strictly between zero and one and the realized offdiag motion differs from raw motion
gates.P8_motion_and_work_disclosure: step norm, policy KL, teammate birth-arrival KL, optimizer updates, completed/cancelled work, and evaluation work are finite and reported separately
gates.P9_no_outcome_selected_setting: task, estimator, learning rate, interaction matrix, horizons, thresholds and comparators equal this frozen configuration
gates.P10_public_quality_anchor: upstream HAA2C task learnability anchor is executed separately before any GPU preregistration; not required to read this pilot
gates.P11_no_formal_or_gpu_escalation: pilot never counts as formal evidence and any failed mandatory gate stops GPU escalation
gates.P12_reproducibility: endpoints.csv and curves.csv are byte-identical in an isolated unchanged rerun

decision_rule: P1-P9 and P11-P12 are mandatory for CPU survival; P10 must pass before a GPU preregistration. No failed threshold, seed, task, method, estimator or horizon may be changed after outcome access.
